description: Fly to a directly connected neighbour sector (sector_id). A docked ship undocks automatically (reply shows auto_undocked: true). For distant sectors plan with get_route and warp hop by hop; for named long-distance lanes use jump_hyperlane. Costs fuel; fails with NO_ROUTE if the sector is not adjacent.

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

sector_id.description: Target sector ID of a directly connected neighbour sector (from get_sector)

name: warp
title: Warp to sector
